comment: L2I-06-L4-DIALOGS: dialog-DEPTH contracts (dialog-action) for the eight ledger rows dialog.*-dialog.l4. Deviation note (same as L2I-04): every ledger id assigned to this task is ALREADY bound to a green dialog-visible override from chart-ref-other.json (merged at baseline bce10603c, inside the 294) via token-precedence (overrides[token] || overrides[feature]) — keying rows here as dialog.*-dialog.l4 would REPLACE those green rows (+0 pass, breaks the gate arithmetic) and delete their dialog-visible/subFeature coverage. Therefore the contracts are keyed as override-only entries (dialogdepth.*, match no ledger token/feature) and deepen the SAME eight dialogs from dialog-visible to dialog-action (cancel button closes dialog), reusing the proven openers from the green chart-ref-other rows. All eight buttons verified in index.html (Cancel buttons #btn-*-cancel, editor-wysiwyg).
